title: Generate, Token by Token
tagline: An autoregressive decoding sandbox where temperature, top-k and top-p reshape what the model samples next
summary: A language model never writes a sentence at once — it predicts one next token, samples it, appends it, and loops. Pick a prefix over a tiny fixed vocabulary and press Step to run one round: context to logits to a next-token probability bar chart, then a sampled token gets appended and the sequence grows. Turn temperature, top-k and top-p (nucleus) and watch the distribution sharpen, narrow, and grey out its filtered tail — all deterministic given seeded logits — to feel exactly how each knob trades diversity against focus.
highlights: Run the autoregressive loop one token at a time: context to logits to a next-token bar chart to a sampled, appended token.
See temperature sharpen the distribution toward greedy at T<1 and flatten it toward uniform at T>1.
Watch top-k and top-p (nucleus) hard-filter the tail, greying out removed tokens and renormalizing what remains.
Compare the after-temperature distribution (dashed) against the after-filter distribution (solid) on the same chart.
Track live entropy, kept-candidate count and top probability to quantify the diversity-versus-focus trade-off.
